size.label: Width (px)
size.description: Widget width; the height follows the content.

primary.label: Primary ayanamsa
primary.description: "Fagan/Bradley" or "Lahiri": used for dignities and the highlights. Both are always shown in the table; nakshatras always use Lahiri.

font.label: Font
font.description: Font family for the text; a monospaced font keeps the columns tidy (list them with: fc-list : family).

font_size.label: Font size
font_size.description: Size of the body text in px; the table shrinks if it would not fit.

sanskrit.label: Sanskrit names
sanskrit.description: Show the nakshatras and the Lahiri and Nakshatra column headings in Devanagari (needs Noto Sans Devanagari).

order.label: Planet order
order.description: Heliocentric: Sun, Mercury, Venus, Earth, Moon, Mars… (as in Orrery). Geocentric: Earth, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Sun, Mars… (the Ptolemaic order).
